description: Korean customs practice estimates (관세법): mode travel = traveler's duty-free USD 800 and 20% simple rate with 30% self-report reduction (cap KRW 200,000) or 40%/60% penalty; mode direct = personal direct-purchase orders arriving the same day bundled against the USD 150 (USD 200 from US) exemption; mode rvc = FTA regional value content build-down or build-up against a threshold; mode refund = simplified fixed-rate drawback (간이정액환급) per KRW 10,000 of FOB with the 2-year claim limit. Rates come from the user; no classification or declaration.

caught.description: travel: caught without reporting (repeat = more than twice in 2 years)

dutyRate.description: direct: duty rate as a fraction (default 0.08)

fx.description: travel/direct: customs FX rate KRW per USD

perTenThousand.description: refund: drawback per KRW 10,000 from the fixed-rate table

rate.description: travel: simple rate as a fraction (default 0.2)

threshold.description: rvc: required RVC as a fraction, e.g. 0.4

totalUsd.description: travel: goods bought abroad in USD (excluding separate liquor/tobacco/perfume allowances)

name: calculate_kr_customs_practice
title: calculate kr customs practice
